L0507

Prefer an ordered arm table for this branch

What

Prefer an ordered arm table for this branch

Why

One ordered arm table is Jet's normal form for multi-line and chained choices

Fix

Write `if { condition -> body else -> body }`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0507: tests/ui_lint/prefer_arm_table.warn.
